references.text: Joseph first demands that the brothers bring their youngest brother to prove they are telling the truth, otherwise they will be held as spies. Verse 20 repeats and confirms this demand.
Judah reminds Jacob that they cannot return to Egypt without Benjamin, a direct follow-up to Joseph's requirement in 42:20.
The brothers do as Joseph said and bring Benjamin to Egypt to prove their innocence and rescue Simeon.
Judah offers himself as a slave instead of Benjamin, showing that the brothers have kept their promise to protect the youngest brother—a strong fulfillment of the obligation from 42:20.
Direct continuation of the same event where Joseph sets the conditions to prove the brothers' honesty.
Direct fulfillment of the requirement in 42:20; Joseph finally meets his youngest brother Benjamin.
